```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<robot name="chest_with_lid">

  <!-- ==================== Base (chest body) ==================== -->
  <link name="base">
    <!-- Visual -->
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.185" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.01 0.51 0.37"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="brown">
        <color rgba="0.55 0.27 0.07 1"/>
      </material>
    </visual>

    <!-- Collision -->
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.185" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.01 0.51 0.37"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>

    <!-- Inertial -->
    <inertial>
      <mass value="20.0"/>
      <!-- Box inertia about its center -->
      <inertia ixx="0.5" ixy="0.0" ixz="0.0"
               iyy="0.6" iyz="0.0"
               izz="0.4"/>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.185" rpy="0 0 0"/>
    </inertial>
  </link>

  <!-- ==================== Lid ==================== -->
  <link name="lid">
    <!-- Visual -->
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.01" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.01 0.51 0.02"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="dark_brown">
        <color rgba="0.4 0.2 0.1 1"/>
      </material>
    </visual>

    <!-- Collision -->
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.01" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.01 0.51 0.02"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>

    <!-- Inertial -->
    <inertial>
      <mass value="5.0"/>
      <!-- Box inertia about its center -->
      <inertia ixx="0.02" ixy="0.0" ixz="0.0"
               iyy="0.025" iyz="0.0"
               izz="0.015"/>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.01" rpy="0 0 0"/>
    </inertial>
  </link>

  <!-- ==================== Hinge Joint ==================== -->
  <joint name="lid_hinge" type="revolute">
    <!-- Joint origin is at the back edge of the chest, at the top surface -->
    <origin xyz="0 0.255 0.37" rpy="0 0 0"/>
    <parent link="base"/>
    <child link="lid"/>
    <!-- Axis X (rotate upward) -->
    <axis xyz="1 0 0"/>
    <limit effort="100" velocity="1.0" lower="0" upper="1.5708"/>
    <dynamics damping="0.1" friction="0.2"/>
  </joint>

</robot>
```
